name: GCS Bucket Enumeration
description: Listing Cloud Storage buckets is how an attacker learns which piles of data exist before they download anything. It is the GCP equivalent of S3 ListBuckets: map first, steal later. Inventory jobs do this on a schedule. People almost never do it by hand across a whole project. A new service account listing buckets, then objects, is recon.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
